company.shortDescription: Cyberdesk provides virtual desktops for deploying AI agents using simple code.
company.description: Cyberdesk provides virtual desktops for deploying AI agents using simple code. It allows users to launch and interact with AI agents on these desktops. The platform is open source and offers code on GitHub for further customization. Users can start a demo to interact with a computer agent that runs on Cyberdesk. The service focuses on AI deployment and virtual desktop management.

productsAndServices.description: An AI agent built on the Cyberdesk platform that interacts with users through the virtual desktop, capable of executing tasks via natural language commands.
